shortDescription: Create, Update or Delete OSPF configuration on AOS-CX

options.name: active_interfaces
options.description: The list of the active-interfaces. If "passive_interface_default" is set to "false", then this list should be empty.

options.name: admin_router_id
options.description: The router identifier configured for the OSPF instance. The router ID MUST be unique within the entire Autonomous System. If admin_router_id is present, the same will be elected as active_router_id. The router ID is in IPv4 address format.

options.name: auto_cost_ref_bw
options.description: The reference bandwidth, Mbits/second, for interface cost calculations. Must be in [1, 4000000].

options.name: bfd_all_interfaces_enable
options.description: Enables BFD on all interfaces involved in this OSPF Router

options.name: default_originate
options.description: Criteria for redistribution of the default routes into the OSPF domain: disable: no default route should be advertised. originate: advertise default route if it exists in the routing table. always_originate: always advertise default route, regardless of its presence in the routing table.

options.name: distance
options.description: Administrative distances.

options.name: gr_ignore_lost_interface
options.description: Specifies whether to ignore OSPF interfaces that have gone down just prior to the restart event.

options.name: helper_disable
options.description: Indicates whether OSPF will help a neighbor undergoing hitless restart on this interface.

options.name: instance_tag
options.description: OSPF Process ID, in [0, 63]

options.name: lsa_arrival
options.description: Minimum wait time in milliseconds before same LSAs received from a peer are processed. Must be in [0, 600000]

options.name: lsa_throttle
options.description: Timers related to LSA throttling.

options.name: maximum_paths
options.description: Maximum number of equal cost paths that are stored for each destination in the routing table.

options.name: other_config
options.description: Miscellaneous configuration

options.name: passive_interface_default
options.description: This determines whether all interfaces should be set to passive by default.

options.name: passive_interfaces
options.description: List of passive interfaces. If "passive_interface_default" is set to true, then this list should be empty.

options.name: protocol_disable
options.description: Disable this OSPF instance

options.name: redistribute
options.description: From where to redistribute routes from other sources into this OSPF instance, if the same source also has a route map based filter associated with it, only the filtered routes will be redistributed into this instance.

options.name: redistribute_ospf
options.description: Redistribute routes from other OSPF instances into this OSPF instance. If the same instance also has a route map based filter associated with it, only the filtered routes will be redistributed into this instance.

options.name: restart_interval
options.description: If OSPF is attempting to undergo a graceful restart, this field specifies the length in seconds of grace period that should be requested from adjacent routers in grace LSAs. Must be in [5, 1800].

options.name: snmp_traps
options.description: The configurations related to the OSPF SNMP traps.

options.name: spf_throttle
options.description: Timers related to SPF throttling.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, update, or delete the OSPF Router.

options.name: strict_lsa_check_disable
options.description: Specifies whether strict LSA checking is disabled for this OSPF router instance.

options.name: stub_router_adv
options.description: Configurations related to stub router and router_lsa advertisements.

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF the OSPF Router will belong to once created. If none provided, it will be in the Default VRF. If the OSPF Router is created and the user wants to change its VRF, the user must first delete the OSPF Router, and then recreate it in the desired VRF.
